findings.subject: dashboard-page, chat-page, onboarding-page, settings-page, sign-in-page, app-view (page template)
findings.summary: Six of seven page templates have no 768 or 1440 evidence; only list-page is captured at tablet and wide.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/.storybook/visual.setup.ts:25-32 returns the 1280 viewport for every story outside templates-pages-list-page--; scripts/design-system/check-templates.mjs:4 requires only Desktop/Phone/Themes; baseline sizes: only list-page has 768/1440 PNGs
findings.fix: Add Tablet and Wide stories (tabletGlobals/wideGlobals) to every page, let visual.setup map the -tablet/-wide suffix for all templates, and make check:templates require them.

findings.subject: activity-list, auth-card, chat-panel, getting-started-checklist, settings-section, stat-row
findings.summary: Blocks with breakpoints (stat-row lg, settings-section lg) or not used by list-page are captured only at 1280 and 390.
findings.evidence: stat-row.tsx:34, settings-section.tsx:28; baselines templates-blocks-*-desktop (1280) and -phone (390) only
findings.fix: Cover them at 768 and 1440 through the page stories above, or add Tablet stories to these blocks.

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: AppView's Phone* stories are captured at 1280, so layout="phone" has no 390 baseline in ui-react, and the md/lg window breakpoints are never captured.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-appview-phone-with-tab-bar-chromium-linux.png is 1280x900; visual.setup.ts:26 keys the phone viewport on ids ending in -phone; app-view.css:122,134
findings.fix: Give the phone stories a phone viewport (rename to end in Phone or map globals.viewport in visual.setup) and add a 768 window story where the panel appears.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Below 1280 the aside column is hidden with no fallback, so page navigation passed as aside vanishes on tablets and small laptops.
findings.evidence: reader-layout.tsx:36 `hidden w-64 shrink-0 px-4 pt-8 xl:block`; reader-layout.stories.tsx:25 puts the page nav there; only 1280 baselines
findings.fix: Document the xl cut-off in TSDoc and docs, and either accept an inline fallback (e.g. asideFallback rendered above the article below xl) or recommend PageTableOfContents menu; add phone and tablet stories.

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: Section's responsive padding has no story, baseline or test of its own.
findings.evidence: section.tsx:21-27; no section stories or tests under packages/ui-react/src/layout (only page.test.tsx)
findings.fix: Add a Section story with each spacing preset at phone and desktop, and a unit test for the class map.

findings.subject: app-view (page template)
findings.summary: The phone sample and the `atom63 build` snippet pad the first block with raw env(safe-area-inset-top), bypassing --a63-safe-area-top, the token AppView and checkFrame use.
findings.evidence: packages/templates/src/pages/app-view/app-view.tsx:275; `pnpm -s atom63 build "phone music app"` output snippet; app-view.css:11 reads var(--a63-safe-area-top, env(...)); app-view template stories have no safe-area play
findings.fix: Use pt-[var(--a63-safe-area-top)] in the template and the CLI snippet, and add checkSafeArea to EdgeToEdgePhone.

findings.subject: sign-in-page
findings.summary: The sign-in page has no safe-area owner: on a landscape phone the 16px gutter sits under a 47px inset.
findings.evidence: sign-in-page.tsx:76 `px-4`; page.tsx:16 only pt-8 pb-20; no checkSafeArea in sign-in-page.stories.tsx
findings.fix: Pad the page with px-[max(--spacing(4),max(var(--a63-safe-area-left),var(--a63-safe-area-right)))] and bottom inset, and add checkSafeArea to the Phone story.

findings.subject: Page, ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Neither Page nor ReaderLayout, nor the layout docs, say who owns safe-area insets for a document route outside a shell.
findings.evidence: page.tsx:16; reader-layout.tsx:26; `atom63 docs pattern-layout` 'Choose the layout owner' table has no inset row
findings.fix: Add an inset row to the layout-owner table and have Page (or Container padding) take inline insets via --a63-safe-area-*.

findings.subject: activity-list
findings.summary: ActivityList with no items renders an empty labelled list, and the dashboard has no empty or first-run state.
findings.evidence: activity-list.tsx:42; dashboard-page.stories.tsx has only Desktop/Phone/Themes
findings.fix: Accept an empty prop (or render EmptyState when items is empty) and add an Empty story to the block and the dashboard.

findings.subject: getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: When every step is done the checklist has no current step and no completion state; partly-done and done are not shown.
findings.evidence: getting-started-checklist.tsx:51 `current = steps.find(step => !step.done)`; stories pass all done:false
findings.fix: Add a completion message (and an optional onDismiss) when done === steps.length, and stories for partly done and all done.

findings.subject: page-header
findings.summary: A long title squeezes the actions from sm up because neither side is guarded.
findings.evidence: page-header.tsx:28-30 (no min-w-0 on the title wrapper, no shrink-0 on actions); section-header.tsx:107
findings.fix: Add min-w-0 flex-1 to the title side and shrink-0 to the actions, and a LongTitle story.

findings.subject: stat-row
findings.summary: A long stat value widens its column on phones; there is no long-value story.
findings.evidence: stat-row.tsx:34 `grid-cols-2` (1fr = minmax(auto,1fr)), :40 text-2xl with no wrap guard
findings.fix: Use grid-cols-[repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))] (and for 4), allow the value to wrap or truncate, and add a long-value story.

findings.subject: app-view (page template)
findings.summary: The app view sample shows only a fixed five-track album; no empty library, long title or long list is exercised.
findings.evidence: app-view.tsx:68-82
findings.fix: Add a long-titles / many-tracks story and an empty-library story.

findings.subject: list-page, chat-panel, chat-page, app-view (page template)
findings.summary: Fourteen secondary ghost Buttons in the templates (row menus, reply actions, top bars) lack tone="muted", against AGENTS.md rule 6 and the button contract.
findings.evidence: grep 'variant="ghost"' packages/templates/src (non-story): 14; grep 'tone="muted"': 0. e.g. list-page.tsx:125,202; chat-panel.tsx:108,116,288,293; chat-page.tsx:100; app-view.tsx:104,115,179,195; `atom63 component button` line 89
findings.fix: Add tone="muted" to the secondary icon actions (not the filter-bar clear text button).

findings.subject: list-page
findings.summary: The no-invoices state shows two primary 'New invoice' Buttons, plus a filter bar and a 'no results' icon on a first run.
findings.evidence: list-page.tsx:145 and :170; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/templates-pages-list-page-no-invoices-chromium-linux.png; data-table-section.tsx:95 hard-wires SearchX
findings.fix: Make the empty-state action outline (or drop the header action) when invoices is empty, hide FilterBar at zero records, and let DataTableEmpty pass its icon.

findings.subject: sign-in-page
findings.summary: The sign-in card is meant to be centred but sits at the top of the page.
findings.evidence: sign-in-page.tsx:76 `<Page className="flex items-center px-4">`; Page min-h-full (page.tsx:16) resolves to content height; templates-pages-sign-in-page-desktop-chromium-linux.png shows the card at y=32 with ~480px empty below
findings.fix: Give the sign-in Page min-h-svh (and keep items-center) so the card centres in the viewport.

findings.subject: tab-bar
findings.summary: Tab labels use an arbitrary 11px size that ignores the type scale.
findings.evidence: tab-bar.tsx:58 `text-[0.6875rem]`; text-2xs exists (packages/styles/src/tailwind/theme.css:535) and follows --typography-scale and the phone step
findings.fix: Replace text-[0.6875rem] with text-2xs.

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: AppView names any docked bar 'Player' and any side panel 'Library' by default, so a status bar or channel list gets a wrong accessible name.
findings.evidence: app-view.tsx:94 bottomBarLabel='Player', :101 panelLabel='Library'
findings.fix: Make the label required when the slot is given (type-level), or use neutral defaults and document that callers name them.

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: Section's child-gap ramp is not monotonic: generous is tighter than loose.
findings.evidence: section.tsx:29-35 (loose space-y-8, generous space-y-6, spacious space-y-8)
findings.fix: Make the gap ramp increase with the preset (e.g. generous space-y-8, spacious space-y-10) and add a test.

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: removeTopSpacing defaults to true, so the default Section has no top padding, which surprises a builder.
findings.evidence: section.tsx:18; documented in pattern-layout docs
findings.fix: Decide whether to flip the default (breaking) or keep it documented.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Builders are not led to ReaderLayout: the API answer is an import line only and a reading-page build query does not surface it.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 api ReaderLayout` prints only the import and 'Docs: atom63 docs pattern-layout'; `pnpm -s atom63 build "documentation article page"` lists chat-page/dashboard/list-page, not ReaderLayout
findings.fix: Add TSDoc to every ReaderLayoutProps field and a component description, and include ReaderLayout in the build kit for reading, docs and article intents.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: ReaderLayout hard-codes Tailwind widths instead of Container's named max widths.
findings.evidence: reader-layout.tsx:23 max-w-5xl, :26 xl:max-w-4xl, :36 w-64; layout/max-width.ts
findings.fix: Use containerFrameClassName / a named measure.

findings.subject: getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: Every done step is drawn in the accent colour, exceeding the one-or-two accent cues per view.
findings.evidence: getting-started-checklist.tsx:86-87
findings.fix: Keep the accent on the current step only and draw done steps in the muted/success role.
